title: Valkyrie Over the Fallen
description: A female warrior in armor and flowing cloak stands in a dark village at night, sword in hand, as a brilliant beam of light pierces down from a swirling purple and blue galaxy sky containing a bright full moon. Below her, the reflective water surface reveals the skeleton of a fallen warrior reaching upward, with a small blue bird flying nearby.
prompt: A powerful female warrior with braided hair wearing leather and metal armor stands in a medieval village at night, holding a sword, as a dramatic beam of light shines down from a swirling purple and blue galaxy sky with a large full moon. In the foreground, reflective dark water shows the clear image of a skeleton warrior reaching up from below the surface, a small blue bird flies nearby, dramatic fantasy scene inside an oval frame with dripping paint effects
